author: Liz Sims
text: We can’t thank Lane enough.  He was able to come the same day we called.  Professional, knowledgeable, gave excellent advice, and provided a welcome education.  Very friendly.  Pumped septic tank.  Filled and level off area nicely. Recommended by a friend. Pleased with the price.

author: Kristina Shaw
text: Porta potty service leaves much to be desired,  especially with their long term rentals. They came in while the potty was in use, and rather than wait a moment, they turned around and left without cleaning and now there are 100s if not 1000s of flies boiling out of the toilet. Absolutely ridiculous!!! Not the first time with this issue, but in the past when it got this bad, it was because they just didn't show up for cleaning.

author: Chloe Bishop
text: Grice and Son are the only company our family will work with for our septic needs. Both Craig and Lane are so professional, and they do an awesome job! If you need a new septic tank, or need work done on one, Grice and Son are the guys for the job!

author: Aerielle Georgeoff
text: Superb service! Craig came out right away when we needed our septic tank pumped. He’s very knowledgeable, answered all of our questions, explained things even further, and left us feeling like we were taken care of. Don’t even hesitate to call Grice & Son!

author: Jen Evans
text: Lane came out the same day and got us all fixed up in no time! Very professional and polite!
